title: Create Execution Plan
description: Decompose the design into actionable implementation tasks.
ai_instructions: You MUST follow the Planner Agent Protocol (`planner_agent_prompt.md`) and procedure (`procedure_planning.md`). Prioritize Foundation tasks.
execution_steps: Review ALL architectural artifacts (FCHAIN, LCOMP, API, DATA, UIC) and recommended FRs
Identify and plan Foundation Tasks (Repo, Setup CI, DB)
Decompose work vertically by FCHAIN into sequence of atomic Feature Tasks
Add Human Integration Gate Tasks at the end of every FCHAIN group
Ask user for confirmation to complete task
definition_of_done: All architecture and functions covered by tasks
